page.overview:
Who is Melisie?

Melisie is non-player character in Final Fantasy XIV. She is a noble of Ishgard and the main antagonist of the machinist quests.

Melisie was born from a noble family of Ishgard and as such shares the same mentality of many nobles regarding commoners. She soon joined the Inquisitors ascending quickly in rank.

After the changes of politics of Ishgard and commoners ascending in power, Melisie

Melisie is a woman with long red hair and green eyes. She is dressed with a white dress with long brown gloves and fur over her shoulders.
